item.title: 'The View' guest host praises Trump economy as panel blasts admin for rising prices amid Iran conflict
item.summary: CNBC's Sara Eisen says rising gas prices from the Iran conflict are likely temporary, but "The View" but multiple co-hosts objected to such speculation.

item.title: Iran’s new supreme leader linked to properties with ‘line of sight’ into Israeli UK Embassy
item.summary: Two London apartments linked to Mojtaba Khamenei sit less than 50 meters from the Israeli Embassy which a terrorism specialist says constitutes a serious security breach.

item.title: Feds investigate alarming near miss between Alaska Airlines jet, FedEx plane at busy Newark airport
item.summary: Federal authorities will investigate a reported close call at Newark airport involving an Alaska Airlines and FedEx aircraft on crossing runways Tuesday night.

item.title: Iranian women’s soccer team returns home after declining asylum in Australia: report
item.summary: Iran’s women’s soccer team reportedly returned home after several players sought asylum in Australia. Two players accepted asylum offers and have remained in the country.

item.title: Reality TV star Jordan Wright found dead in drainage canal at 33
item.summary: Reality TV star Jordan Wright from "The Only Way Is Essex" has died at age 33, after reportedly being found in a Thailand drainage canal near Phuket beach.

item.title: Dems face reckoning after putting deceased labor leader on pedestal as sexual abuse allegations emerge
item.summary: Years of White House proclamations and Democratic praise for Cesar Chavez are now under fresh scrutiny after abuse allegations prompted allies to back away.

item.title: Denmark secretly prepared to blow up Greenland's runways to stop U.S. aircraft: report
item.summary: Denmark disguised a troop deployment to Greenland as a NATO exercise called Arctic Endurance, with soldiers carrying explosives, DR reports, citing 12 high-level sources.

item.title: Nuclear fusion advances, but challenges remain for power grid
item.summary: Nuclear fusion energy could become commercially viable by the early 2030s as scientists work to replicate the sun's power, potentially transforming energy.

item.title: Duke survives stunning halftime deficit to hold off No. 16 seed Siena in March Madness' first round
item.summary: The Siena Saints nearly became the third team in March Madness history to beat a No. 1 seed as a No. 16 seed, but the Duke Blue Devils rallied in the second half to avoid the upset.

item.title: Major city hikes hotel tax to nearly 20% as tourism bosses eye future events
item.summary: Chicago has raised the tourist tax on downtown hotels to 19% to boost tourism marketing efforts. A new district will fund Choose Chicago campaigns and events.
